Arithmetic for durations (mt_duration)

Source: R/arithmetic.R
mt_duration-arithmetic.Rd

Durations (e.g. days(3)) support:

  • Combining: a + b and a - b give a duration in their finest common chronon. The chronons must have a fixed ratio, so months(1) + days(1) is an error.

  • Ratios: a / b is a number (e.g. weeks(1) / days(1) is 7).

  • Scaling: d * n, n * d and d / n.

  • Adding numbers: d + n and d - n count n in d's chronon.

Adding a duration to a time point shifts it, see mt_time-arithmetic.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'mt_duration'
e1 + e2
# S4 method for class 'mt_duration'
e1 - e2
# S4 method for class 'mt_duration'
e1 * e2
# S4 method for class 'mt_duration'
e1/e2

Arguments

e1, e2

Operands, at least one a duration (mt_duration) vector.

Value

A duration, or a number for the ratio of two durations.

Examples

weeks(1) + days(2)
#> <mixtime[1]>
#> [1] 9.0 days
weeks(1) / days(1)
#> [1] 7
days(3) * 2
#> <mixtime[1]>
#> [1] 6.0 days
try(months(1) + days(1))
#> Error : The number of days in a month requires the time context `at`.
